name: Caz Gecesi
scene: A golden alto saxophone curves through flowing blue and teal night bands in an oval stained-glass panel.
notes: Target 38–48 panes. Generated with image_gen using the old saxophone as subject reference and vitray_lighthouse/vitray_poppies as style references; revised once after visual inspection. Remaining doubts: subtle fill shading persists; adjacent gold pieces at mouthpiece, bell shoulder and lower bend may merge during tracing; close junctions near the mouthpiece and bell should be checked on traced geometry. Palette lists intended flat colours. Design sheet only; no game assets or catalogue changed.
